confidence_notes: Citywide 2026 price estimates provide a reasonable basis for meals, coffee and beer. Accommodation is a broad model estimate with substantial seasonal and location variation. Cocktail and wine estimates use their typical price relationship to restaurant beer because direct citywide data is limited.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Sanya city price indexes. Accommodation estimates reflect general knowledge of Hainan’s coastal resort market and July seasonality.
